pr_body:
After this change, users can get the python zip file of a certain
target without using `--build_python_zip` by

`bazel build //foo:bar --output_groups=python_zip_file`

or
```
filegroup(
  name = "bar_zip",
  srcs = ["//foo:bar"],
  output_group = "python_zip_file",
)
```

Fixes https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3530
pr_title: Add python zip file to a output group
pr_comment: This feels like a very promising alternative to subpar executables inside Docker containers. 👍
Thanks for the review and importing!

review_comment: "Create the stub file used for a non-zipfile executable. If --build_python_zip is true this is never used so we skip it."
